atomic_ism.description: Cold and warm atomic interstellar gas in the Milky Way and nearby star-forming environments, including H I 21 cm emission and absorption, HISA, HINSA, CNM and WNM, neutral clouds, H I shells, and the atomic-to-molecular transition.

molecular_clouds.description: Molecular clouds and molecular gas: cloud formation, structure, evolution, kinematics, CO and other molecular-line observations, dense gas, filaments, clumps, and cores.

star_formation.description: Star formation from cloud to core and young stellar object, including gravitational collapse, protostars, prestellar cores, protostellar envelopes, accretion, young clusters, and interactions between young stars and natal gas.

feedback_bubbles.description: Stellar feedback acting on interstellar matter, including OB stars, H II regions, bubbles, cavities, shells, stellar winds, supernova feedback, feedback on atomic or molecular clouds, triggered star formation, and Galactic superbubbles.

turbulence.description: Turbulence and gas dynamics in the interstellar medium and molecular clouds, including velocity statistics, power spectra, structure functions, linewidths, density and column-density PDFs, and turbulent driving.

magnetic_fields.description: Magnetic fields in the interstellar medium and star-forming clouds, including dust polarization, Zeeman measurements, MHD in interstellar gas, magnetic support, field morphology, and interstellar magnetic reconnection.

astrochemistry.description: Astrochemistry and molecular tracers in interstellar and star-forming gas, including chemical evolution, abundances, deuteration, ionization, cosmic-ray chemistry, and diagnostic molecular species in clouds and cores.

massive_star_formation.description: Massive star and cluster formation in dense molecular environments, including infrared dark clouds, massive clumps, high-mass protostars, hot cores, massive young stellar objects, and clustered star formation.

galactic_ism.description: The Galactic interstellar medium on large scales, including Milky Way gas and dust, the Central Molecular Zone, Galactic-center gas, H I and molecular-line surveys, local cavities and shells, and three-dimensional dust and gas structure.

ism_methods.description: Observational, statistical, computational, and radiative-transfer methods directly useful for interstellar-medium and star-formation research, including spectral decomposition, gas tomography, map reconstruction, and molecular or atomic line analysis.

negative_topics.solar_physics: Solar physics, solar flares, coronal heating, the solar atmosphere, sunspots, helioseismology, or Solar Orbiter work without an interstellar-medium objective.
negative_topics.stellar_evolution: Individual-star atmospheres, photospheres, interiors, stellar evolution, evolved stars, red giants, red supergiants, AGB stars, rotation, or stellar variability when the ISM is only background context.
negative_topics.planetary_disks: Planet formation, protoplanetary and debris disks, exoplanets, planetesimals, planetary atmospheres, and planetary systems when the natal cloud or star-forming environment is not the main science target.
negative_topics.compact_objects: Black holes, neutron stars, pulsars, X-ray binaries, gamma-ray bursts, relativistic jets, gravitational waves, and compact-object accretion not centered on interstellar gas.
negative_topics.relativistic_plasma: Collisionless or relativistic plasma physics, particle-in-cell simulations, collisionless shocks, tidal disruption events, fast blue optical transients, and high-energy plasma processes without an ISM target.
negative_topics.generic_mhd: Generic plasma, shock, turbulence, dynamo, or MHD theory applicable broadly but not specifically focused on interstellar gas, molecular clouds, or star formation.
negative_topics.galaxy_evolution: Galaxy evolution, AGN, high-redshift galaxy populations, galaxy morphology, cosmological galaxy simulations, and metallicity calibration where the primary target is the galaxy rather than Galactic or local ISM physics.
negative_topics.cgm_igm: Circumgalactic or intergalactic gas around external galaxies, baryon-cycle studies, reionization, and cosmological 21-cm science rather than the Galactic or local ISM.
negative_topics.cosmology: Cosmology and large-scale structure, dark matter, dark energy, CMB, lensing, galaxy clustering, and early-universe physics unrelated to local interstellar matter.
negative_topics.nuclear_particle: Dense nuclear and quark matter, compact-star equations of state, hadronic matter, and particle or nuclear physics without an interstellar-medium objective.
negative_topics.generic_instrumentation: General telescope, detector, calibration, pipeline, or instrumentation development whose scientific application is broad and not specifically motivated by ISM or star-formation measurements.
